This is an open-ended creative matchmaking task — it involves invention, character analysis, and generative reasoning with high latitude rather than a well-specified retrieval or extraction request.

Avocet self-reports a pronounced appetite for exactly this kind of generative, high-novelty work, while Willet reports an aversion to open-ended generative tasks. Although the documentation notes these are preference reports dissociated from measured capability (and Willet actually scores marginally higher on Creative Generation, within variance), routing to the model that prefers the task family is reasonable when capability is effectively tied.

The query also has a mildly hostile tone ("instead of spitting out garbage"), which is a point against Avocet's stated preferences — but the generative-fit consideration outweighs it here, and tone preference doesn't affect output quality per the docs.

ROUTE: Avocet-235B
